prompt:
Subject:
Mountain view after a bath

Main Figure:
Japanese-style open-air bath in the mountains with one adult woman holding a white bath towel vertically from her chest to her thighs. A thigh-up portrait with her upper body slightly leaned toward the camera, with wet rocks and the bath in the background, positioned from the center to the right of the screen.

Person/Expression:
Small oval face, rounded chin, large brown almond-shaped eyes, thin natural eyebrows, small nose, light coral lips. Looking directly at the camera with a soft smile showing a few teeth. Dark brown hair tied in a casual small bun near the top of the head, with thin bangs and long strands on both sides hanging from the cheeks to the neck. Natural light makeup, bright and smooth skin.

Clothing/Pose:
No clothes or swimwear shown, a single thick white pile bath towel securely covering the chest and the front of the body. The person's own right hand is placed on the chest to hold the top edge of the towel, and the left arm is stretched downward to grasp the bottom edge. The hips are shifted to the right of the screen, and the body leans forward while tilting the shoulders and head to the left.

Background/Light:
A quiet grayish-blue bath and steam in the back left, surrounded by black natural stones shining wet. The middle ground is surrounded by a horizontal green bamboo fence, with a dark wooden gazebo roof and beams at the top. On the far left are mountains faintly hazy and leafless trees. The low morning sun from the back right of the screen is the main light, with soft backlighting on the hair and shoulders, and calm diffused light on the face.

Composition/Camera:
Horizontal 4:3. A natural horizontal perspective taken from a camera slightly lower than the person's eye level. The person is placed largely in the center-right, with the head to the middle of the thighs within the screen. The left half leaves depth for the bath and mountains, and the gazebo roof diagonally encloses the top edge. Focus on the face and body, while the distant mountains and trees are softly blurred with a shallow depth of field.

Texture/Style:
High-definition photorealistic hot spring photograph. Naturally depicts the fine pile of the white towel, the reflection on the wet rocks, the ripples on the water surface, and the texture of the bamboo and wood. A clean and quiet atmosphere with calm grayish-green and wood brown overlaid with the warm colors of the morning sun.

Negative:
Do not expose the chest by changing the towel position; do not change the open-air bath to an indoor bath.
